zh: 工具栏 AI → 安装或导出 Skill… → 安装到 Codex。用 $equation-lab 检查 Word 公式、编号和引用，或批量编辑后另存副本。长文档可先显示公式目录，再补齐内容和按需加载缩略图；窄窗口与重试提示也更清楚。
en: Choose AI → Install or Export Skill… → Install for Codex. Use $equation-lab to check Word equations, numbering, and references, or batch-edit a new copy. Long documents can show the equation directory first, with content and thumbnails loaded as needed. Narrow windows and retry prompts are clearer.
